summary.en: What one item looks like in a counted film: a rounded square, a dot of the same area, or a pictogram (page, box, chip); it wears base, the accent, a swell or rest.
summary.zh: 计数片里一件事的样子：圆角方块、等面积圆点，或图标（页面、盒子、芯片）；颜色只有基色、强调、放大和退灰几种状态。

fits: Any unit chart: one mark, one item, the same mark for the whole film.
notFor: Marks that stand for several items or a percentage; separating categories by shape.

intent.en: One mark stands for one item all film, so a viewer can count with their eyes.
intent.zh: 一个标记整片代表一件东西，观众能用眼睛数。

content.en: Nothing but the choice of form: square, dot or a pictogram (page, box, chip).
content.zh: 只需选形状：方块、圆点或象形（页、盒、芯片）。

fits.zh: 任何单位图：一个标记，一件东西，整片同一种标记。

notFor.zh: 代表多件或百分比的标记；靠形状区分类别。

en: Never separate categories by shape; colour and place do that.
zh: 不要用形状区分类别，靠颜色和位置。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
